Esteve expects to launch Inbrija in Spain in the fourth quarter of 2022.

FDA Approves Fusion Pharma's Clinical Study of Investigational Radiopharmaceutical
Fusion Pharmaceuticals Inc. (NASDAQ: FUSN) said the Food and Drug Administration has cleared its investigational new drug applications FPI-1966 and imaging agent FPI-1967. FPI-1966 is a targeted alpha therapy designed to use vofatamab, a human monoclonal antibody, to target and deliver actinium-225 to tumor sites expressing fibroblast growth factor 3, a protein that is overexpressed in multiple tumor types, particularly head and neck and bladder cancers.
Fusion said it plans to initiate a Phase 1, non-randomized, open-label clinical trial in patients with solid tumors expressing FGFR3 intended to investigate safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics and to establish the recommended Phase 2 dose.
The stock was up 12.55% at $9.24 in premarket trading.

Satsuma Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: STSA) announced randomization of the first subject in its SUMMIT Phase 3 efficacy trial of STS101 for the acute treatment of migraine.

Aeglea submitted an FDA marketing application for pegzilarginase in Arginase 1 Deficiency.

Novartis Highlights Early Data From KRAS Inhibitor At AACR Meeting
Novartis AG (NYSE: NVS) shared clinical data for JDQ443, an investigational selective, covalent and orally bioavailable KRASG12C inhibitor.
Preliminary Phase 1b data showed that JDQ443 demonstrated anti-tumor activity, high systemic exposure at its recommended dose and a favorable safety profile in KRAS G12C-mutated solid tumors.
FDA Identifies Labeling Deficiency In Pfizer-Myovant's Myfembree Supplemental Application
The FDA identified deficiencies that preclude discussion of labeling and/or post-marketing requirements related to Myovant Sciences Inc (NYSE: MYOV) and Pfizer Inc's (NYSE: PFE) Myfembree for endometriosis-associated pain.
The agency did not provide additional detail.
